svg.text: What the storefront shows today — and what the OS gives it
nine pages, measured from sbx-6hrgnvda5zy72gi6.arena.site · every form currently ends in a toast
place on any page via Puck
no number, no record, no follow-up
convert to order in one click
1,913 lines across those seven pages · 0 fetch() calls · 0 server-side submits · 0 records created
The designs exist. The backend behind them does not. That is the entire upgrade.
